title: No reverse-engineering success after eight decades

tellings.quote: the senior VP at at one of the aerospace corporations who I had years worth of interviews with uh before and after he retired um confirmed that there was no success in the reverse engineering program after eight decades and it just didn't go anywhere.

plain: A secret effort to reverse engineer recovered craft, meaning to take them apart and learn to copy them, has had no success after eight decades and "just didn't go anywhere." Eric W. Davis, a physicist who has advised the Pentagon, says a senior vice president at an aerospace company told him so over years of interviews, before and after the man retired. If true, it would mean the program existed but failed.
